title: Boston Gas Company files for review and approval a Firm Transportation Agreement with New England and Children's Waltham Medical Center LLC.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Judith F. Judson, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul G. Afonso, and Brian Paul Golden. (DTE 06-GC-7)
